lkh.mirror_selection_reason: author server inaccessible from inspected entry points; freeze an uncustomized source mirror before any performance evaluation

lkh.continuous_distance_input: rounded full explicit distance matrix at scale1e6; final quality recomputed on original continuous distances, integer approximation disclosed; TSPLIB EUC_2D input exact rounded integers

protocol.timing: preparation/functional fixture checks only while main is active; formal wall-time evaluations after all training/discovery load ends
